gold_comments.issue_summary: shouldn't this be `None` by default. That's what we do everywhere else in the deeplake repo and it works well, so I think we should adhere to conventions we have elsewhere in order to de-risk edge cases not working.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added line `runtime={‘tensor_db’: False},` in the __init__ signature must be present at head.
gold_comments.rationale: Using a mutable default argument like a dict can cause unexpected shared state across instances, and the reviewer correctly noted that None is the conventional default elsewhere in the repo.
gold_comments._reviewer_comment_full: shouldn't this be `None` by default. That's what we do everywhere else in the deeplake repo and it works well, so I think we should adhere to conventions we have elsewhere in order to de-risk edge cases not working.
